name: @vesper/astro
description: The Vesper integration for Astro: the studio at /admin, schema helpers and config.
//exports: @vesper/source points workspace tooling at TypeScript source; everyone else gets dist/. "." is the integration (astro add); ./node is Node-only (config loading, manifest, local storage).
//files: pages/ holds the injected /admin page; src/ and dist/ both resolve it at ../../pages.
//peerDependencies: The site's own Astro: schemas, loaders and Zod must come from the same copy the site builds with (spec §6.3). React is the studio's, shared with the site's custom widgets (spec §6.3.3).
//devDependencies: Tailwind compiles the studio stylesheet from source in this workspace only; published sites get dist/studio.css.
